item.title: Krist Wollum Announces Run For State Senate District 21
item.description: PORTER, Minn. — Lincoln County farmer Krist Wollum has announced plans to run for the Minnesota Senate in District 21, the seat being vacated by Sen. Bill Weber, R-Luverne, who is retiring this fall. Wollum is a grain and cattle farmer from rural Porter and serves as legislative chair of the Minnesota State Cattlemen’s Association. [...]

item.title: Chris Knoll Announces Run for State Senate District 21
item.description: SAINT JAMES, Minn. — Chris Knoll, CEO of Minnewaska Community Health Services, has announced his candidacy for the Minnesota State Senate in District 21. Knoll is seeking the Republican Party endorsement. He said District 21 needs continued conservative representation at the Capitol.
